headlines.title: Get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until Friday
headlines.summary: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

headlines.title: Jim Cramer says investors should consider buying SpaceX for their kids
headlines.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors should view SpaceX as a multigenerational investment, whose biggest opportunities may take decades to fully materialize.

headlines.title: As Warsh and the Fed contemplate fewer meetings, markets brace for potential volatility ahead
headlines.summary: Since taking office in May, Warsh has implemented several measures that reverse decades of Fed culture.

headlines.title: Sandisk’s stock falls as the company’s forecast doesn’t live up to high expectations
headlines.summary: The midpoint of the company’s revenue forecast was below what analysts had been modeling.

headlines.title: Block slashed 40% of its workforce for AI — and its earnings suggest that’s paying off
headlines.summary: “We can ship higher-quality products much, much more quickly,” an executive said in the wake of the company’s better-than-expected earnings report

headlines.title: Figma’s stock falls as the company’s AI push requires steep investments
headlines.summary: While Figma’s consumption-based AI monetization strategy is showing promise, the company’s margins are taking a hit.

headlines.title: Hollywood is cranking out billion-dollar movies again. 'Spider-Man' just joined the ranks
headlines.summary: Box office analysts say the resurgence of billion-dollar releases bodes well for a film industry that's still chasing pre-Covid levels, even with higher prices.

headlines.title: SpaceX ramps up Tesla Megapack purchases in Q2 to power its AI data centers
headlines.summary: SpaceX is using Tesla's big Megapack backup batteries to help power its Colossus AI data centers in Greater Memphis.

headlines.title: Nikita Bier steps down as X’s head of product
headlines.summary: The serial entrepreneur is stepping down a little over a year after taking the "24/7 job" of overseeing X.

headlines.title: Why AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile shares are down after SpaceX’s earnings
headlines.summary: SpaceX thinks it will be able to build wireless capabilities without massive network investments.

headlines.title: Travis Kalanick’s robotics startup Atoms taps former Uber finance chief as CFO
headlines.summary: Kalanick continues to get the band back together, after acquiring Anthony Levandowski's autonomy startup, and even soliciting investment from Uber itself.

headlines.title: SpaceX’s stock falls as Wall Street gets spooked by the extent of AI spending
headlines.summary: Morgan Stanley expects $64 billion in capital spending from SpaceX this year, as the company is dramatically ramping up AI investments.

analysis.summary: Fed Funds Rate 3.63，近 3 期趨勢 持平；美國 10 年期公債殖利率 4.617，近 3 期趨勢 連續下降；VIX 15.81，近 3 期趨勢 最近一期下降。整體總經風險分級：medium。

economy.summary: Fed Funds Rate 3.63，近 3 期趨勢 持平；美國 10 年期公債殖利率 4.617，近 3 期趨勢 連續下降；VIX 15.81，近 3 期趨勢 最近一期下降。整體總經風險分級：medium。

strategies.price_above_ma200: 收盤價高於 200 日均線時持有，否則空手。
strategies.ma20_cross_ma60: 20 日均線高於 60 日均線時持有，否則空手。
strategies.buy_and_hold: 買入持有基準，用於比較策略是否優於單純持有。

assumptions.transaction_cost_note: 每次部位變化扣除 0.1% 交易成本，用於保守估計。
assumptions.lookahead_bias_control: 策略使用前一交易日訊號承擔下一交易日報酬，避免偷看未來資料。

signals.disclaimer: 研究訊號僅供分析，不是買賣建議。
